claims.citation: New York Herald, 22 September 1866, p. 8, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Borussia (Ham), Schwensen, Hamburg Sept 2,
via Southampton 5th, with mdse and 646[?] passengers, to Kun-
hardt & Co. Experienced strong westerly winds and heavy
sea throughout the passage; lost about 48[?] hours by dense fog
and an accident to the engine.

claims.citation: Hubbard & Winter, North Atlantic Mail Sailings 1840-75 (USPCS, 1988; rev. 2014), p. 180
